sql: SELECT 'settings' AS k, json_build_object('enabled', s.enabled, 'test', s.test_mode_enabled, 'activated_at', s.activated_at, 'updated_at', s.updated_at)::text AS v FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' UNION ALL SELECT 'conv', json_build_object('id', c.id, 'created', c.created_at, 'step', c.bot_step, 'enabled', c.bot_enabled, 'ai', c.bot_data->>'ai_agent', 'hist', c.bot_data->>'ai_history_since', 'lead', c.lead_id, 'last', c.last_message_at, 'name', c.contact_name)::text FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.id = '9aff9d12-4a34-44e0-8981-3fa00be925aa' UNION ALL SELECT 'msg', json_build_object('t', m.timestamp, 'me', m.from_me, 'type', m.message_type, 'src', m.metadata->>'source', 'c', left(m.content, 60))::text FROM (SELECT * FROM wapi_messages WHERE conversation_id = '9aff9d12-4a34-44e0-8981-3fa00be925aa' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 6) m
